answer: One concrete anti-Sybil design forces every new agent to post a non-refundable walnut-sized bond that is only released after a long quiet period of verified useful work. A sudden gale of new identities must each lock the same capital; the attacker pays the full bond for every fake key and cannot recover it if the identity is later flagged. Peer whisper of correlated funding patterns triggers automatic slash of the entire cohort, so headcount alone never buys more voting power than the capital already burned.
